title: Renegotiate the analytics contract
transcript:
[00:00] Nadia: The analytics contract renews on November 30th. Do we keep them?
[00:07] Tomasz: Usage is down. Only the growth team still logs in every week.
[00:14] Nadia: Then let's renegotiate instead of renewing as is. Can you get a quote for ten seats instead of twenty-five?
[00:24] Tomasz: Sure. I'll ask their account manager for the ten-seat price by Thursday.
[00:31] Nadia: If it's under eight thousand a year, we sign. If not, we look at alternatives.
[00:39] Tomasz: Under eight thousand, got it. Should I give them notice that we might not renew?
[00:46] Nadia: Yes, the contract needs thirty days' notice, so send it before October 31st.
[00:52] Tomasz: I'll send the notice tomorrow and copy you.
[00:56] Nadia: Thanks. And export last year's dashboards in case we switch.
[01:01] Tomasz: Will do. I'll put the exports in the shared drive.
